description: This file defines an abstract class 'Catalog' which provides an interface for catalog operations in Apache Spark SQL, including database, table, function, and cache management.

classes.name: Catalog
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for catalog operations in Spark SQL, including listing databases, tables, functions, managing cache, and catalog metadata.

methods.name: currentDatabase
methods.description: Returns the current database (namespace) in this session.

methods.name: setCurrentDatabase
methods.description: Sets the current database (namespace) in this session.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of databases (namespaces) available within the current catalog.

methods.name: listDatabases(pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of databases matching the pattern.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views in the current database, including temporary views.

methods.name: listTables(dbName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views in the specified database.

methods.name: listTables(dbName: String, pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views in the specified database matching the pattern.

methods.name: listFunctions
methods.description: Returns a list of functions in the current database, including temporary functions.

methods.name: listFunctions(dbName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of functions in the specified database.

methods.name: listFunctions(dbName: String, pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of functions in the specified database matching the pattern.

methods.name: listColumns
methods.description: Returns a list of columns for a given table/view or temporary view.

methods.name: listColumns(dbName: String, tableName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of columns for a table/view in a specified database.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves a Database object for the specified database name.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves a Table object for the specified table/view name.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a Function object for the specified function name.

methods.name: databaseExists
methods.description: Checks if a database exists.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table/view exists.

methods.name: functionExists
methods.description: Checks if a function exists.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a table from a path or data source with various overloads for schema, options, and description.

methods.name: dropTempView
methods.description: Drops a local temporary view.

methods.name: dropGlobalTempView
methods.description: Drops a global temporary view.

methods.name: recoverPartitions
methods.description: Recovers partitions for a partitioned table.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if a table is cached.

methods.name: cacheTable
methods.description: Caches a table in-memory, with optional storage level.

methods.name: uncacheTable
methods.description: Removes a table from cache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached tables.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes metadata and cache for a table.

methods.name: refreshByPath
methods.description: Invalidates cache for datasets containing the given path.

methods.name: currentCatalog
methods.description: Returns the current catalog in the session.

methods.name: setCurrentCatalog
methods.description: Sets the current catalog in the session.

methods.name: listCatalogs
methods.description: Lists available catalogs.

methods.name: listCatalogs(pattern: String)
methods.description: Lists catalogs matching the pattern.
